subject: Pilot financial snapshot + volume checklist
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Morales <ben.morales@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenhealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot financial snapshot + volume checklist

Hi Ben / Procurement — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can lock an initial invoice sketch for the pilot.

Recap of call:
- Primary use: clinical triage assistant + intake summarization (mostly short prompts + long context retrieval).
- Peak concurrency: low (mostly async), but spikes during morning windows.
- Typical prompt lengths: median ~300 tokens, occasional long contexts up to 8k tokens.

Estimated monthly token tiers (pulled from your Qs):
- Conservative: 250M tokens / month
- Likely: 600–800M tokens / month
- Upside: ~1.2B tokens / month (6–12 months if adoption accelerates)

Budget guidance we heard on the call: $80k–$140k / month (prelim). You mentioned a target unit economics target of ~$400–$450 per 1M tokens.

What I attached:
- pilot_estimate_v1.xlsx — simple invoice sketch with line items (hosted tokens, storage, SLA add-on)
- redwood_pricing_calculator.csv — interactive calc you can open to vary volumes and see effective $/1M

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm which monthly tier we should model (conservative / likely / upside)?
2) Confirm whether data residency must be US-East or if US multi-region is acceptable.
3) If procurement wants a PO path, share the contact and approximate PO timeline so we can include a formal invoice cadence (monthly vs. net30).

If you prefer, I can update the sketch for the Likely band (600–800M) and we can run a quick pricing call tomorrow to align.

Thanks — I’ll hold on updating the estimate until I get confirmation of the tier and residency.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Ben Morales <ben.morales@lumenhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenhealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 18:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Pilot financial snapshot + volume checklist

Thanks Chloe — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: we spent 30m after the call reviewing internal telemetry and a likely first-phase rollout looks like ~600–800M tokens / month (that aligns with the "Likely" bucket you called out).

Budget: the team is comfortable in principle with a pilot budget in the $80k–$140k / month range, but that assumes we can hit an effective unit cost around $400–$450 per 1M tokens for the hosted endpoint.

Specific asks for the updated sketch: 
- Please provide a sample invoice with line items: hosted inference tokens, request/response storage, KV cache persistence (if applicable), and any SLA/priority routing fees.
- Show at least two scenarios: (A) hosted pay-as-you-go with committed minimums (200M/mo) and (B) reserved/dedicated baseline for 3-month pilot with burst headroom.
- Confirm data residency — we need US only (preferably US-East).

Procurement note: procurement@lumenhealth.com asked that any pilot estimate include expected invoicing cadence and cancellation terms. I can loop in the legal PO contact next week once we have the sketch.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — if you can get an updated estimate by EOD Monday PST, we should be able to review and set a follow-up call on Tuesday.

Best,
Ben Morales
Head of AI Product, Lumen Health
ben.morales@lumenhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0987

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot financial snapshot + volume checklist

Forwarding Ben's reply — he confirmed 600–800M/mo, budget 80–140k/mo, target ~$400–$450/1M. Procurement wants invoice line items + cadence + cancellation terms. Residency must be US only (US-East preferred).

Attachments I updated for internal review:
- pilot_estimate_v2.xlsx (updates the line-item breakdown with both Hosted and Dedicated scenarios)
- pricing_scenarios_600-800M.pdf (simple charts: effective $/1M by model + commit length)

Internal asks (quick):
- Sean: can you propose 2 commercial pathways we should present: (1) Hosted API with commit discount and monthly min, (2) Dedicated reserved pilot with effective $/1M and a recommended commit term. Include recommendation for a 3-month pilot vs. 6-month.
- Vivek: any operational constraints for US-East only for this pilot? If Dedicated, what lead time and footprint?

Quick internal note: if they take Dedicated at ~700M, we can probably get to an effective $/1M in the low-mid $200s with a 3–6 month commit and predictable burst policy. Hosted will require a higher $/1M but faster time-to-value.

I plan to turn this into a customer-facing two-slide pricing summary + updated invoice sketch by EOD Monday. Thoughts?

—Chloe

Thanks — quick take below so you can update the customer-facing sketch: 

Scenario A — Hosted (fastest launch)
- Offer: $450 / 1M tokens baseline for PAYG with a committed monthly minimum of 200M.
- Commit discount: 10% off baseline for a 3-month commit (effective $405 / 1M).
- For 600–800M: effective monthly range = $243k–$324k (note: above their stated budget; we should present a blended approach or usage cap).
- Cancellation / invoicing: monthly invoice, net30, 14-day pilot cancellation window.

Scenario B — Dedicated reserved pilot (recommended if they want lower unit economics)
- Offer: reserved capacity with 3-month term; pricing modeled as an effective $/1M based on a reserved GPU pool.
- Recommended price: effective $230 / 1M at 700M usage (3-month commit).
- For 700M -> $161k / month effective cost (this falls inside the high end of their stated budget if we include predictable discounts / usage smoothing).
- Lead time: 5–7 business days for provisioning in US-East; include burst-to-hosted policy to handle spikes.

Recommendation / next step:
- Send both sketches to Ben (I can sign off on the math). For the customer call, lead with Hosted for speed-to-proof + a clear migration path to Dedicated if usage hits sustained 600M+ for 4 weeks.
- Update pilot_estimate_v2.xlsx with the two scenarios and a short 1-pager that summarizes cancellation / PO terms.

I can hop on the Tue pricing call to walk through the line items.

—Sean
